messages:
Maya: EOD triage — quick check-in. Open tickets: 18 (5 P0/P1). New regression: embeddings pipeline intermittently returning 500s for Customer A; stack shows 'KV cache miss' in runtime. Filed SUP-4872 and linked logs. Updated macros for embedding-fallback and reroute-to-dedicated.
Liam: Re: Maya — I can pick up SUP-4872 overnight. Can you paste the exact logs you saw?
Maya: Added the console trace to the ticket and a short log snippet. Also pushed the macros I mentioned: 
Maya: ```/macro embed-fallback -> reroute model=embedding-small if status=500 and attempts>1
/macro escalate-oncall -> notify @on-call-bot + add tag P0```
Sam: Copy that — I'll validate the macro behavior in staging tomorrow AM and run the harness against the failing trace. Ticket volume looks steady vs last week. I'm finishing a KB draft for common embedding errors.
devex-bot: Macro 'embed-fallback' deployed to prod (v1.2) by Maya.
Tara: FYI customer B reported slow dashboard loads; looks correlated with high embedding queue. I moved two heavy jobs to the dedicated pool and cleared a backlog. Monitoring now.
Liam: Thanks Tara. Anyone able to cover the 9–11am PST rota tomorrow? I have interviews.
Maya: I can cover 9–10. @Sam can you take 10–11? :thumbsup:
Sam: Yep I can take 10–11, thanks.
on-call-bot: Incident SUP-4860 resolved — latency spike traced to quantization fallback; automatic rollback executed and verification checks passed.
Maya: Blockers: none beyond SUP-4872. Today: finish KB, finalize playbook for embeddings fallback, handoff 9–11 coverage to Liam/Sam. Ping me in-thread for anything urgent.
